title: Pelota - Mesoamerican Ballgame — free 3D browser game; desktop simulator-style, mobile arcade
author: Wide-Bobcat-3723
selftext:
I'm the solo creator of Pelota, a free browser game inspired by the Mesoamerican ballgame.

Play here: [https://pelota.io](https://pelota.io/)

You play a Sun Bearer alongside a computer partner against the Lords of Xibalba. You can strike the heavy rubber ball with your hips, knees or forearms, never your hands or feet.

Score by getting two bounces on their side, sending the ball into the end wall behind them, or landing a stone-ring shot for +2. First to 11.

Desktop is the more simulator-like version: you move with WASD, aim with the mouse and choose between three rebindable strikes. Mobile is an arcade mode with automatic running and touch gestures.

No install or sign-up. The first load is about 80 MB, so allow a little time on a slow connection.

I built it with heavy AI assistance: code written with Claude, characters and props generated with Meshy, animation with Mixamo, and music with Suno. It's inspired by the historical ballgame, not a scholarly reconstruction.

If you try it, I'd like to know whether aiming and the point rules make sense on your first match.
